JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'LATAM'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND NOT c.is_internal
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

WITH exchange_rates AS (
    -- USD exchange rates are not available in the supplied schema.
    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
        ('EUR', 100.0, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)),
        ('JPY',   1.0, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE))
    ) AS r(currency, minor_units_per_unit, usd_per_unit)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.amount_minor,
        r.minor_units_per_unit,
        r.usd_per_unit
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN exchange_rates AS r ON r.currency = o.currency
    WHERE c.region = 'ANZ'
      AND NOT c.is_internal
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(usd_per_unit) = COUNT(*) THEN
            AVG(amount_minor / minor_units_per_unit * usd_per_unit)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS average_order_value_usd_before_refunds,
    'EUR-to-USD and JPY-to-USD exchange rates are required but not provided.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM eligible_orders;

SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * $eur_to_usd
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor * $jpy_to_usd
        END
    ) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'MEA'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT

        * CASE o.currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN $eur_to_usd / 100.0
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd
          END
    ) AS gross_apparel_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'apparel'

SELECT

        CASE o.currency

            WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd

    ) AS gross_revenue_usd

JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

SELECT

JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

SELECT

            WHEN 'JPY' THEN $jpy_to_usd_rate

    ) AS gross_revenue_usd

JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'outdoors'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY');

SELECT

            CASE o.currency
                WHEN 'EUR' THEN CAST($eur_to_usd AS DOUBLE) / 100.0
                WHEN 'JPY' THEN CAST($jpy_to_usd AS DOUBLE)

    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'beauty'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT
    o.currency,
    SUM(oi.qty::HUGEINT * oi.unit_price_minor)
        / CASE WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN 100.0 ELSE 1.0 END
        AS gross_revenue_native,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(38, 2)) AS gross_revenue_usd,
    'USD revenue cannot be calculated without EUR/USD and JPY/USD exchange rates.'
        AS conversion_note
FROM orders AS o

JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
